chapter_seo_title: Xiao Chen Humiliates a Heavenly King – Chapter 448
chapter_meta_description: Wu Ming, the undefeated Heavenly King, flees in terror after two sentences. Xiao Chen reveals himself, humbles the arrogant Xiao Asura, and heads toward a confrontation with the Tiger clan.
og_description: Wu Ming, the legendary Heavenly King, retreats in panic. Later, Xiao Asura is defeated with a single palm. Xiao Chen’s quiet return shakes the capital.
twitter_title: Heavenly King Terrified by Two Words
twitter_description: Wu Ming, widely feared as an undying Heavenly King, flees at a mere sentence. Xiao Chen’s power is felt once more.
